name: Phyn - Jellyfin Media Player
summary:
Phyn is the media player for the Jellyfin library you control. Stream films and series, browse Live TV, enjoy music and audiobooks, and keep your eBooks together in one polished app.

**Discover more to watch**

Explore new movies and TV shows, see what is popular, and use personalised recommendations based on your viewing preferences.
